questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion to emphasise the subject in a negative conditional structure?
options: If she hadn’t been exhausted, she would have finished the report yesterday.
Only when he realised the mistake did he admit his error publicly.
Had it not been for your help, we would never have completed the project on time.
Unless you apologise immediately, we will cancel our plans for tomorrow.
questions.answer: Only when he realised the mistake did he admit his error publicly.

questions.question: Which cleft sentence correctly restates the subject of the original sentence while maintaining the intended meaning?
options: It was the unexpected feedback that convinced him to reapply for the job.
The reason he left early was because of the traffic jam.
What surprised everyone was that the team had achieved such a high score.
The fact that she was late was entirely due to her car breaking down.
questions.answer: What surprised everyone was that the team had achieved such a high score.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses a third conditional structure with the subjunctive mood to express regret about past actions?
options: If she had studied harder, she would have passed the exam.
If they had known about the meeting earlier, they would have attended.
If he hadn’t spent so much time on social media, he would have finished his thesis sooner.
If we had received the budget approval sooner, we would have started the project.
questions.answer: If he hadn’t spent so much time on social media, he would have finished his thesis sooner.

questions.question: Which sentence demonstrates the correct use of ellipsis in a formal academic context, omitting redundant information while preserving clarity?
options: The study, which was conducted over three years, demonstrated significant findings.
After reviewing the data, it became clear that the experiment’s results were inconclusive.
The participants, being all volunteers, were unaware of the study’s true purpose.
The findings, that were statistically significant, were published in the journal.
questions.answer: The participants, being all volunteers, were unaware of the study’s true purpose.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly employs a nuanced formal register choice, using a passive construction with a semi-modally to convey a cautious or indirect implication?
options: The proposal was suggested by the committee to be reviewed by the board.
It was decided that the project would be delayed due to resource constraints.
The findings were reported as being consistent with previous research.
The decision was made that further investigation would be necessary before proceeding.
questions.answer: The findings were reported as being consistent with previous research.
